title: Inside the Nightclub Sheltering Haitians From Violent Gangs
summary_full: Club International was once a popular music venue in Port-au-Prince. Now it’s a makeshift shelter for hundreds of Haitian families fleeing gang violence, and the club’s owner wants them out.
